event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: An arbitration meeting was held prior to the hearing. ESP 225924 did not withdraw the protest after the arbitration meeting.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
ESP 225924 was represented by Vincent Krueger Amengual.
CRO 211911 was represented by Lorenzo Bertolino.
Marcos Plomer (coach of ESP 225924) attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 4-6 knots of wind and irregular small chop.
ESP 225924 and CRO 211911 were sailing downwind both on starboard tack towards mark 3p, before the last reach to the finish line.

CRO 211911 was sailing for the whole downwind clear ahead and in front of ESP 225924. ESP 225924 was sailing faster and started catching up. When ESP 225924 was 15-17 metres away from the mark, she established an overlap to windward to CRO 211911.
CRO 211911 entered the zone overlapped inside of ESP 225924.

When CRO 211911 was beside the mark, gybed to port tack. The distance between her and the mark was around 0.5 meter. At that moment ESP 225924, already on port tack, was 1 meter to leeward of CRO 211911.
ESP 225924 bore away slightly, while CRO 211911 was rounding the mark.
There was no contact between the boats.
conclusions: ESP 225924 outside overlapped at the zone gave mark-room to CRO 211911, as required by RRS 18.2(a)(1)
decision: The protest is dismissed. No rule is broken.
